Our batteries sit behind the meter at industrial sites, so every decision has to balance customer savings, grid constraints and market value under uncertainty. Our data scientists and quantitative researchers work as one team and often across each other's topics. What you will do The role covers two closely linked areas. You can work in either one and switch between them as priorities and your interests evolve: Fleet optimization: Plan how each battery runs over the coming hours and days, combining customer savings, grid fee rules and market value within each site's limits. Forecasts of load, PV and prices are generated and fed into the plan, which has to stay robust to their uncertainty. You also measure how much value we actually capture. On-site control: Make the plan work in reality. jobs.description: About the role Since 2009, SkyNRG has been a change maker in the aviation industry. We are dedicated to supplying and producing high-integrity Sustainable Aviation Fuel (SAF), making sustainable aviation a reality. As our Digital Product Intern, you’ll play a hands-on role in maintaining and improving SkyNRG’s digital platforms. You’ll work on both frontend and backend updates to skynrg.com , manage content through WordPress, and support FlyOnSAF, our platform where individual travelers and small and medium-sized businesses can purchase SAF. Your Responsibilities Website development: Build and update website pages, templates and styling using HTML5, CSS and PHP, and make backend changes within WordPress. Content management: Maintain and update content across skynrg.com and FlyOnSAF using our CMS. Analytics & reporting: Create regular performance reports using GA4 and other analytics tools, identifying opportunities for improvement. Digital support: Support the Marketing & Communications team with day-to-day digital activities and share your ideas and progress with the team.
